newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market inactive - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market inactive - USDA.

text.p: Trade was quiet, with no sales slaughter steers or heifers confirmed, USDA said.
Inquiry and demand rather light. Bids 67.00, asking 70.00, last confirmed sales 67.00 Thursday, April 10. Sales confirmed for the week to date including late Friday and the weekend on 600 cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Confirmed - none week ago - none year ago - none
Wk to date - 600 week ago - 2,900 year ago - 1,100
